functions.name: update-contact
functions.description: Partially update a contact. Supplied information and membership arrays replace those entire collections.

infos.description: Complete replacement information collection; [] deletes all entries.

label.description: Documented category for the chosen kind.

value.description: Info value except facebook and address.

memberships.description: Complete replacement membership collection; [] removes every membership.

contactBookId.description: Destination book ID when changing the book.

changes.description: Partial profile changes. Omission preserves; empty strings clear text and empty arrays clear collections. Null is not accepted.

FunctionInput_missive_updatecontact.description: Contact identity and partial replacement changes.

FunctionOutput_missive_updatecontact.description: Identity and modification state returned by the contact update.

tags.instructions: Get the contact with `get-contact` before editing infos or memberships: supplied arrays replace all existing entries, and [] clears them. Omitted fields are unchanged. Use `batch-update-contacts` for multiple contacts. This can remove existing contact information.

functions.name: update-conversation
functions.description: Partially update a conversation's subject, color, assignment, labels, access or team routing without creating a post; optionally close or reopen it.

conversationId.description: Current or old merged conversation ID.

color.description: HEX or semantic color; clearing is not exposed without documented support.

state.description: Close or reopen for everyone with access.

teamId.description: New team when unlinked; forceTeam replaces an existing team.

subject.description: New conversation subject; empty requests clearing.

forceTeam.description: Whether to replace an existing team; genuine routing behavior, not confirmation.

destination.description: Move to Inbox for everyone or to the specified team's Inbox.

addAssigneeIds.description: Assign organization members, preserving other assignees.

organizationId.description: Organization context required for access, assignment and added labels.

addSharedLabelIds.description: Add visible organization labels, retaining other labels.

items.description: Shared label ID whose association is removed.

changes.description: Partial changes; omitted fields are untouched, null is disallowed.

FunctionInput_missive_updateconversation.description: One conversation and the partial changes to apply without creating a post.

id.description: Current conversation ID returned after the change.

lastActivityAt.description: Latest activity in UTC if returned.

FunctionOutput_missive_updateconversatio.description: The current conversation ID and resulting subject and latest activity when returned.

tags.instructions: Get the conversation with `get-conversation` first if its context is unknown. Organization is required when adding users, changing assignees or adding labels; team is required for team-inbox routing. Label changes run rules and system events may appear. Changes to Inbox, close or reopen affect everyone with access. Use `batch-update-conversations` for several targets.

functions.name: update-response
functions.description: Partially update one reusable response. Supplying attachments replaces its complete attachment collection; external-integration templates are immutable.

userId.description: New personal owner, exclusive with organizationId.

bodyHtml.description: Replacement HTML, with cid: references for supplied files.

attachments.description: Complete replacement files; [] removes all, omitted retains all.

inlineId.description: Temporary ID matching cid: images in replacement HTML.

contentBase64.description: Exact file bytes in standard base64, including retained files.

items.description: A file in the complete replacement collection.

organizationId.description: New organization owner, exclusive with userId.

shareWithTeamId.description: Replacement sharing team; null provisionally clears.

changes.description: Only attributes to change; omitted attributes remain.

FunctionInput_missive_updateresponse.description: Identify one reusable response and the attributes to change.

id.description: Updated response ID; get-response reads its complete state.

tags.instructions: Use `list-responses` or `get-response` first. Omit fields to preserve them. Include all files to keep when replacing attachments; [] removes all. External templates such as WhatsApp templates cannot be updated. Use `batch-update-responses` for multiple targets.

functions.name: update-shared-label
functions.description: Partially update a shared label. Sharing and visibility changes require admin/owner authority; basic users may edit name, color and parent.

parentId.description: New parent; null provisionally moves to root.

visibility.description: Replacement label usability scope, admin/owner only.

shareWithTeamId.description: Replacement sharing team; null provisionally clears.

shareWithOrganization.description: Replacement organization sharing; false removes rule.

FunctionInput_missive_updatesharedlabel.description: A shared label and the attributes to partially update.

FunctionOutput_missive_updatesharedlabel.description: The updated shared label identity, name, and full path.

tags.instructions: Find the ID with `list-shared-labels`. Omit fields to preserve them. Sharing changes may grant or remove conversation access; admin/owner authority is required for sharing and visibility. Use `batch-update-shared-labels` for multiple targets.

functions.name: update-team
functions.description: Partially update team membership, local business hours and routing settings. Requires admin/owner authority.

timeZone.description: Named timezone retaining local weekly meaning.

endTime.description: Local end after start; 24:00:00 provisionally allowed.

items.description: One local business-hours interval on a weekly day.

anyOf.description: Local weekly business hours with their named timezone.

organizationId.description: Replacement organization field; cross-organization transfer not promised.

items.description: User ID for an active team member.

FunctionInput_missive_updateteam.description: A team ID and the selected attributes to partially update.

FunctionOutput_missive_updateteam.description: Identity, name, and owner organization returned for the updated team.

tags.instructions: Use `list-teams` for ID/current settings and `list-users` for members. Omit fields to retain them; role arrays and business hours replace their complete corresponding values. Changes can remove access or disable features. Use `batch-update-teams` for multiple targets.
